chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from al-Fadl ibn 'Abd al-Malik, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام: Is salat over the deceased performed in the masjid? He said: Yes.

key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the masjid, the place being asked about for performing the prayer
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person over whom funeral salat is offered
key_terms.نَعَمْ: yes; an explicit affirmation of permissibility
key_terms.يُصَلَّى: is performed; here, the funeral salat is being referred to

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat over the deceased in the masjid?
ai.summary: This hadith states that salat over the deceased may be performed in the masjid. It serves as a concise legal ruling concerning the permitted place for funeral prayer.
